reviews.title: Free trial advertised, charged immediately
reviews.text:
Update: The developer has now confirmed in writing that there was “a bug in our subscription banners” and that the issue was “on our end.” They also promised to refund the full amount.  
I appreciate that they investigated and acknowledged the problem, but as of now I still have not received the promised refund despite providing my receipt and PayPal information and following up.  
This confirms that the misleading free-trial experience was not simply a misunderstanding on my part. I will update this review again once the promised refund is actually received.

The app advertised a “3-Day Free Trial,” with “Try for Free” and “No payment now” shown on the subscription screen. I subscribed because of those terms, but I was immediately charged $29.99 for a full annual subscription instead of receiving the advertised trial. I requested a refund right away, but it was denied. This was a very misleading and frustrating subscription experience. I would strongly recommend taking screenshots of the subscription terms before purchasing.

reviews.text: Not what it claims, they claim it’s free it’s not, the app doesn’t work at all and I couldn’t even use it on my device. I tried for 2 times and I read the tutorials and everything still wouldn’t work. So today I was like well I’m just going to delete my account and uninstall, while doing so to my surprise I find that it said there’s a THREE DAY FREE TRIAL. Which was news to me, I was under the impression it was free. So I then canceled it which I downloaded it on the evening of March 31st, and today is the 2nd of April. So I cancel it and about 45 minuets later I get a notification from my bank of a $5.99 charge and I’m just confused because I only had it 2 days, and even if I or anyone else had it for 3 days THEY SAY FREE THREE DAY TRIAL, which IMPLIES THE 3RD DAY IS FREE AS WELL AS THE FIRST TWO!! So I emailed them about this and explained to them everything and that I was charged for a product I didn’t get to use and that didn’t work on my device, and though I didn’t know that there was any charges or trials upon me finding out about it I deleted it on day 2 and was still charged and that I wanted a refund and they refused me a refund and told me to take it up with apple and they were sorry, had they actually been sorry they’d of rectified the incident. DON’T USE THIS APP. ONLY AFTER MONEY.
